# Built dashboard assets — do not edit by hand

`seller.html`, `task.html`, `seller.js` and `seller.css` are generated by
[`apps/dashboard`](../../dashboard) (`pnpm --filter @atm/dashboard build`).
Edit the React source there and commit the rebuilt output together with it.
The daemon serves these files as-is from `~/.atm/app/ui` with its existing
routes and Content-Security-Policy.
